metadata.name: IODP Expedition 383 Site U1539 Sediment Core Geochemical and Physical Properties
metadata.description: This dataset contains geochemical and physical measurements from sediment core samples collected during IODP Expedition 383 at Site U1539 in the South Atlantic Ocean. The data includes sediment depth, age estimates, sea surface temperature (SST) reconstructions, and cluster classifications for 150 samples. All samples originate from a single drilling location at approximately 56.15°S, 115.13°W, with bathymetric depths around 4081 meters below sea level. The samples span a sediment depth range of 86.93 to 237.52 meters below seafloor, corresponding to ages between 0.49 and 1.32 million years (Pleistocene epoch).
